WITH v_account AS (SELECT account.account_id AS account_id, account.district_id AS district_id, account.frequency AS frequency, account.date AS date FROM account), v_card AS (SELECT card.card_id AS card_id, card.disp_id AS disp_id, card.type AS type, card.issued AS issued, disp.account_id AS account_id, client.district_id AS district_id, account.frequency AS frequency, account.date AS date FROM card LEFT JOIN disp AS disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id LEFT JOIN client AS client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id LEFT JOIN account AS account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id) SELECT v_account.account_id, v_card.frequency
FROM v_account
